verdict.rationale: Overage fee transparency is a fair question for a usage-billed hosting platform, but the pack has no first-party documentation of an overage fee schedule for bandwidth, function invocations or build minutes. On-topic community reports point the other way: a user hit an unexpected $104k bill after a DDoS, and another could not find pricing at all. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
